section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measurement of mental toughness, including the 18-item short form of the MT48 and the development of new domain-specific items and subscales for video- and computer games. Four dimensions were identified for the domain-specific scale: self-belief, resiliency, task focus, and desire to succeed. The section also reports on the structural validity of the domain-specific mental toughness scale.
